cirque-colors-nail-polish: Smooth, self-leveling jellies and magnetics; sheer jellies need coats.
cnd-solaroil: Stronger, less peely nails; the strong scent is the main complaint.
dazzle-dry-nail-lacquer: Dries in minutes and outlasts gel for many; chips and costs a lot.
deborah-lippmann-nail-lacquer: Glossy with standout glitters; streaky or pricey for some.
essie-break-fix-liquid-nail-patch: Flexible patch for peels and small cracks; big splits don't hold.
essie-gel-couture: Plump gloss for a week or two; it shrinks, especially when thick.
essie-gel-couture-top-coat: Plump, glossy week of wear; tip shrinkage grows as it ages.
essie-gel-setter-top-coat: Thick, gel-like shine that dries fairly fast; it shrinks.
essie-good-to-go-top-coat: Fast, glossy and little shrinkage; stringy for a few.
essie-hard-to-resist-advanced-nail-stren: Strengthens thin nails and cuts peeling with a glossy finish.
essie-nail-polish: Nice creme shades and brush; it chips within days.
essie-speed-setter-fast-dry-top-coat: Dries very fast, often beats Seche Vite; gummy mid-bottle.
essie-strong-start-base-coat: Gentle go-to base that helps peeling; no help for a few.
glamnetic-press-on-nails: Strong glue lasts up to three weeks; some pop off, slow removal.
holo-taco-nail-oil-pen: Mess-free, refillable cuticle oil pen; a couple leaked or broke.
holo-taco-nail-polish: Opaque one-coat cremes for a week; the formula is thick.
ilnp-nail-polish: Good value for a week of wear; it thickens and can be sheer.
kiss-colorfx-by-impress: Easy on and off at good value; the sticky edge shows.
kiss-impress-press-on-manicure: Natural look with no damage for a week or two; some lift early.
manucurist-green-nail-polish: Thin, quick-drying and gentle; may need two coats.
mooncat-getting-even-nail-primer: Ridge-filling tinted base that dries fast; doesn't last for a few.
mooncat-nail-polish: Long wear and liked brushes; the thick formula may need thinner.
mooncat-speed-demon-top-coat: Dries fast and hard with plump gloss; thickens by halfway.
olive-june-gel-polish: Beginner-friendly gel for a week or two; some shades are sheer.
olive-june-pressies: Adult sizes fit and last two weeks; kids' sizes didn't stay on.
opi-repair-mode-bond-building-nail-serum: Quickly strengthens peeling nails; some saw lifting or dryness.
opi-xpress-on: Two weeks or more on busy hands; the curve is strong for a few.
orly-gelfx-builder-in-a-bottle: Easy, long wear for beginners; thick, so shaping takes practice.
orly-nail-lacquer: Comfy paddle brush and big bottles; lighter shades are sheer.
sally-hansen-color-therapy: Easy flat brush and a week of wear; chips in chunks for a couple.
sally-hansen-dries-instantly-top-coat: Dries in minutes with lasting shine; it cracked polish for a couple.
sally-hansen-hard-as-nails: Cheap base that helps polish last; others saw brittleness or nothing.
sally-hansen-insta-dri-top-coat: Fast and cheap with little shrinkage; it can chip or crack.
sally-hansen-miracle-gel: A week or more with no lamp; chipping and thickness bother some.
sally-hansen-miracle-gel-top-coat: Shiny with little shrinkage; slower than quick-dry top coats.
sally-hansen-vitamin-e-nail-cuticle-oil: Dependable cuticle oil people rebuy, with a small brush.
seche-vive-instant-gel-effect-top-coat: Quick gel-like shine that shrinks less than Seche Vite; smelly.
